### oraPromise

Run an action under a spinner, and land on the right symbol whichever way it ends.

```ts
function oraPromise<T>(action: Promise<T> | ((spinner: Ora) => Promise<T>), options?: PromiseOptions<T> | string): Promise<T>;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `action` | `Promise<T> \| ((spinner: Ora) => Promise<T>)` |
| `options` (optional) | `PromiseOptions<T> \| string` |

**Returns** `Promise<T>`

const spinners: Record<string, SpinnerDefinition>;

## Interfaces

### Options

```ts
interface Options {
    text?: string;
    prefixText?: Affix;
    suffixText?: Affix;
    spinner?: SpinnerDefinition | string;
    color?: Color | false;
    hideCursor?: boolean;
    indent?: number;
    interval?: number | undefined;
    stream?: OraStream;
    isEnabled?: boolean;
    isSilent?: boolean;
    discardStdin?: boolean;
}
```

### OraStream

What ora writes to: the runtime's stderr by default, anything stream-shaped in a test.

```ts
interface OraStream {
    write(chunk: string, encoding?: unknown, callback?: unknown): boolean;
    isTTY?: boolean;
    columns?: number;
    rows?: number;
    cursorTo?(x: number): unknown;
    moveCursor?(dx: number, dy: number): unknown;
    clearLine?(direction: number): unknown;
    once?(event: string, listener: () => void): unknown;
    removeListener?(event: string, listener: () => void): unknown;
}
```

### PersistOptions

```ts
interface PersistOptions {
    symbol?: string;
    text?: string;
    prefixText?: Affix;
    suffixText?: Affix;
}
```

### PromiseOptions

```ts
interface PromiseOptions<T> extends Options {
    successText?: string | ((result: T) => string);
    failText?: string | ((error: unknown) => string);
    successSymbol?: string;
    failSymbol?: string;
}
```

### SpinnerDefinition

```ts
interface SpinnerDefinition {
    interval?: number;
    frames: string[];
}
```

## Types

### Affix

A prefix or suffix, resolved on every frame when it is a function.

```ts
type Affix = string | (() => string);
```

### Color

```ts
type Color = 'black' | 'red' | 'green' | 'yellow' | 'blue' | 'magenta' | 'cyan' | 'white' | 'gray';
```

### PrefixTextGenerator

```ts
type PrefixTextGenerator = () => string;
```

### Spinner

```ts
type Spinner = SpinnerDefinition;
```

### SuffixTextGenerator

```ts
type SuffixTextGenerator = () => string;
```
